title: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents differen
question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?

prediction.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT c.db_year,
         col.primary_collision_factor AS cause,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, col.primary_collision_factor) AS rn
  FROM case_ids c
  JOIN collisions col ON c.case_id = col.case_id
  WHERE col.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.db_year, col.primary_collision_factor
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT db_year,
         GROUP_CONCAT(cause ORDER BY rn) AS top2
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY db_year
),
mode AS (
  SELECT top2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM top2
  GROUP BY top2
)
SELECT t.db_year
FROM top2 t
JOIN mode m ON t.top2 = m.top2
WHERE m.n = 1
ORDER BY t.db_year
LIMIT 1;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH yr AS (
  SELECT c.db_year, co.primary_collision_factor pcf, COUNT(*) n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, co.primary_collision_factor) rn
  FROM case_ids c JOIN collisions co ON co.case_id=c.case_id
  WHERE co.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.db_year, co.primary_collision_factor
)
SELECT db_year,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN pcf END) top1,
       MAX(CASE WHEN rn=2 THEN pcf END) top2
FROM yr
GROUP BY db_year
ORDER BY db_year;
